question: Why are merit and demerit identified as the bondage of the three worlds?
premises: Merit and demerit form a pair
It is called the bondage of the three worlds
inference: The duality of merit and demerit binds beings within the three worlds.
uncertainties: The syntax linking yaḥ asau to the pair is compressed.
plain_english: Merit and demerit, those two, are the bondage of the three worlds.
